description: Give one thing a new name: a dialog with a single field, Enter to save; an empty name cannot submit and an unchanged one closes without `onSave`. It stays a block of its own where <FormModal> and <ConfirmDialog> did not, because it carries BEHAVIOUR a Modal cannot: the reseed on open, the focus-and-select exactly once, Enter, and those submit semantics. Arrangement belongs in Modal; behaviour is what earns a name (2026-08-26). Copy: the title names the thing being renamed — "Rename recording" — and the field label is the value, not the act: "Name", not "New name".

props.name: open
props.description: The caller owns it, and it should close once the rename has been accepted, not when the button was pressed.

props.name: initial
props.description: The current name. The field opens seeded with it, selected.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Called only with a trimmed, non-empty name that differs from `initial`.
